Summary

The BILLING program is a batch billing processing system that reads customer and usage data to calculate charges and generate invoices. It applies tiered usage rates, volume and premium discounts, tax calculations based on customer-specific tax rates, and incorporates previous balances to produce a final invoice amount written to an output invoice file. This is a standalone main/driver program with no called subprograms or CICS interactions.
- **Execution Environment**: Batch - **Database Access**: Sequential Files - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main/Driver module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Read Usage Record - Read each customer usage record from the usage file, capturing customer ID, number of units consumed, and the billing month for processing 2: Find Customer - Search the customer file to locate the customer record matching the current usage record's customer ID 3: Validate Customer Status - Check whether the found customer has an ACTIVE status; skip billing and log an error if the customer is inactive or not found 4: Determine Usage Rate - Assign a per-unit billing rate based on tiered usage levels: rate of 0.50 for up to 500 units, 0.45 for 501–1000 units, and 0.40 for more than 1000 units 5: Calculate Usage Charge - Multiply the total units consumed by the applicable per-unit rate to compute the gross usage charge 6: Apply Volume Discount - If the customer's usage exceeds the volume threshold of 1000 units, apply a 10% discount on the usage charge 7: Apply Premium Customer Discount - If the customer type is PREMIUM, apply an additional 5% discount on the usage charge, added on top of any existing volume discount 8: Apply Minimum Charge Rule - If the usage charge after discounts falls below the minimum charge of $25.00, set the taxable amount to the minimum charge of $25.00; otherwise use the discounted charge as the taxable amount 9: Calculate Tax - Compute the tax amount by multiplying the taxable amount by the customer's individual tax rate 10: Calculate Final Invoice Amount - Sum the taxable amount, the calculated tax, and the customer's previous outstanding balance to arrive at the total amount due 11: Generate Invoice Number - Construct a unique invoice number by combining the billing month and the customer ID 12: Format Invoice Output - Format all monetary values (usage charge, discount, tax, previous balance, total amount) into display-ready formats for the invoice record 13: Write Invoice Record - Assemble and write the complete invoice record containing invoice number, customer ID, customer name, units consumed, usage charge, discount, tax, previous balance, and total amount due to the invoice output file 14: Billing Process Completion - After all usage records are processed, close all files and display a billing process completion message

Datasource Information (3)

Datasource Name Type Usage
CUSTOMER.dat Sequential File Input - Read to retrieve customer details including customer type, status, tax rate, and previous balance for billing processing
USAGE.dat Sequential File Input - Read to retrieve customer usage units and billing month to drive the billing calculation process
INVOICE.dat Sequential File Output - Written with generated invoice records containing invoice number, customer details, usage charges, discounts, taxes, and final amounts

High level flow diagram

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Open Required Business Files to Begin Billing-L1: ```cobol OPEN INPUT CUSTOMER-FILE INPUT USAGE-FILE OUTPUT INVOICE-FILE ``` Read Usage Record to Drive Billing Cycle-L1: ```cobol READ USAGE-FILE AT END SET END-OF-USAGE TO TRUE NOT AT END MOVE USAGE-CUST-ID TO WS-CURRENT-CUSTOMER-ID MOVE USAGE-UNITS TO WS-USAGE-UNITS MOVE USAGE-MONTH TO WS-BILLING-MONTH END-READ ``` Detect End of Usage File to Terminate Billing Loop-L1: ```cobol PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-USAGE ... PERFORM READ-NEXT-USAGE END-PERFORM ``` Locate Customer Record in Customer Master-L1: ```cobol CLOSE CUSTOMER-FILE OPEN INPUT CUSTOMER-FILE PERFORM UNTIL CUSTOMER-FOUND OR END-OF-CUSTOMER READ CUSTOMER-FILE AT END SET END-OF-CUSTOMER TO TRUE NOT AT END IF CUST-ID = WS-CURRENT-CUSTOMER-ID SET CUSTOMER-FOUND TO TRUE END-IF END-READ END-PERFORM ``` Handle Customer Not Found in Customer Master-L1: ```cobol IF CUSTOMER-FOUND ... ELSE DISPLAY "ERROR: CUSTOMER NOT FOUND - " WS-CURRENT-CUSTOMER-ID END-IF ``` Validate Customer Active Status Before Billing-L1: ```cobol IF CUSTOMER-FOUND IF CUST-STATUS = "ACTIVE" PERFORM CALCULATE-BILL PERFORM GENERATE-INVOICE ELSE DISPLAY "ERROR: CUSTOMER IS NOT ACTIVE - " WS-CURRENT-CUSTOMER-ID END-IF END-IF ``` Handle Inactive Customer — Skip Invoice Generation-L1: ```cobol IF CUST-STATUS = "ACTIVE" PERFORM CALCULATE-BILL PERFORM GENERATE-INVOICE ELSE DISPLAY "ERROR: CUSTOMER IS NOT ACTIVE - " WS-CURRENT-CUSTOMER-ID END-IF ``` Determine Per-Unit Rate Based on Usage Tier-L1: ```cobol EVALUATE TRUE WHEN WS-USAGE-UNITS <= 500 MOVE 0.50 TO WS-RATE WHEN WS-USAGE-UNITS <= 1000 MOVE 0.45 TO WS-RATE WHEN OTHER MOVE 0.40 TO WS-RATE END-EVALUATE ``` Calculate Usage Charge from Units and Rate-L1: ```cobol COMPUTE WS-USAGE-CHARGE = WS-USAGE-UNITS * WS-RATE ``` Apply Volume Discount When Usage Exceeds Threshold-L1: ```cobol IF WS-USAGE-UNITS > WS-VOLUME-THRESHOLD COMPUTE WS-DISCOUNT = WS-USAGE-CHARGE * WS-VOLUME-DISCOUNT-RATE END-IF ``` Apply Additional Premium Customer Discount-L1: ```cobol IF CUST-TYPE = "PREMIUM" COMPUTE WS-DISCOUNT = WS-DISCOUNT + (WS-USAGE-CHARGE * WS-PREMIUM-DISCOUNT-RATE) END-IF ``` Enforce Minimum Charge Floor on Taxable Amount-L1: ```cobol IF WS-USAGE-CHARGE - WS-DISCOUNT < WS-MINIMUM-CHARGE MOVE WS-MINIMUM-CHARGE TO WS-TAXABLE-AMOUNT ELSE COMPUTE WS-TAXABLE-AMOUNT = WS-USAGE-CHARGE - WS-DISCOUNT END-IF ``` Calculate Tax Using Customer-Specific Tax Rate-L1: ```cobol COMPUTE WS-TAX = WS-TAXABLE-AMOUNT * CUST-TAX-RATE ``` Calculate Final Invoice Amount Including Previous Balance-L1: ```cobol COMPUTE WS-FINAL-AMOUNT = WS-TAXABLE-AMOUNT + WS-TAX + CUST-PREV-BALANCE ``` Generate Unique Invoice Number from Billing Month and Customer ID-L1: ```cobol STRING WS-BILLING-MONTH DELIMITED BY SIZE "-" CUST-ID DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO WS-INVOICE-NUMBER END-STRING ``` Format All Monetary Values for Invoice Output-L1: ```cobol MOVE WS-USAGE-CHARGE TO WS-DISPLAY-CHARGE MOVE WS-DISCOUNT TO WS-DISPLAY-DISCOUNT MOVE WS-TAX TO WS-DISPLAY-TAX MOVE CUST-PREV-BALANCE TO WS-DISPLAY-BALANCE MOVE WS-FINAL-AMOUNT TO WS-DISPLAY-TOTAL STRING WS-INVOICE-NUMBER DELIMITED BY SIZE "|" CUST-ID DELIMITED BY SIZE "|" CUST-NAME DELIMITED BY SIZE "|" WS-USAGE-UNITS DELIMITED BY SIZE "|" WS-DISPLAY-CHARGE DELIMITED BY SIZE "|" WS-DISPLAY-DISCOUNT DELIMITED BY SIZE "|" WS-DISPLAY-TAX DELIMITED BY SIZE "|" WS-DISPLAY-BALANCE DELIMITED BY SIZE "|" WS-DISPLAY-TOTAL DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO WS-OUTPUT-LINE END-STRING ``` Write Completed Invoice Record to Invoice File-L1: ```cobol WRITE INVOICE-RECORD FROM WS-OUTPUT-LINE DISPLAY "INVOICE GENERATED: " WS-INVOICE-NUMBER ``` Close All Files and Confirm Billing Process Completion-L1: ```cobol CLOSE CUSTOMER-FILE USAGE-FILE INVOICE-FILE DISPLAY "----------------------------------------" DISPLAY "BILL01 BILLING PROCESS COMPLETE" DISPLAY "----------------------------------------" STOP RUN ```

1: Read Usage Record

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Read-Next-Usage-L1: ```cobol READ USAGE-FILE AT END SET END-OF-USAGE TO TRUE NOT AT END MOVE USAGE-CUST-ID TO WS-CURRENT-CUSTOMER-ID MOVE USAGE-UNITS TO WS-USAGE-UNITS MOVE USAGE-MONTH TO WS-BILLING-MONTH END-READ ``` End-Of-Usage-Detection-L1: ```cobol AT END SET END-OF-USAGE TO TRUE ``` Capture-Customer-ID-L1: ```cobol MOVE USAGE-CUST-ID TO WS-CURRENT-CUSTOMER-ID ``` Capture-Units-Consumed-L1: ```cobol MOVE USAGE-UNITS TO WS-USAGE-UNITS ``` Capture-Billing-Month-L1: ```cobol MOVE USAGE-MONTH TO WS-BILLING-MONTH ``` Usage-Record-Ready-L1: ```cobol NOT AT END MOVE USAGE-CUST-ID TO WS-CURRENT-CUSTOMER-ID MOVE USAGE-UNITS TO WS-USAGE-UNITS MOVE USAGE-MONTH TO WS-BILLING-MONTH ```

2: Find Customer

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Reset Customer Search State Before Each Lookup-L_MAIN-PROCESS: ```cobol MOVE "N" TO WS-FOUND-CUSTOMER ``` Reset Customer Search State Before Each Lookup-L_FIND-CUSTOMER: ```cobol MOVE "N" TO WS-END-CUSTOMER ``` Reposition Customer File to Beginning for Each Search-L_FIND-CUSTOMER: ```cobol CLOSE CUSTOMER-FILE OPEN INPUT CUSTOMER-FILE ``` Read Customer Records Sequentially During Search-L_FIND-CUSTOMER: ```cobol PERFORM UNTIL CUSTOMER-FOUND OR END-OF-CUSTOMER READ CUSTOMER-FILE AT END SET END-OF-CUSTOMER TO TRUE NOT AT END IF CUST-ID = WS-CURRENT-CUSTOMER-ID SET CUSTOMER-FOUND TO TRUE END-IF END-READ END-PERFORM ``` Detect End of Customer File During Search-L_FIND-CUSTOMER: ```cobol READ CUSTOMER-FILE AT END SET END-OF-CUSTOMER TO TRUE END-READ ``` Match Customer Record by Customer ID-L_FIND-CUSTOMER: ```cobol NOT AT END IF CUST-ID = WS-CURRENT-CUSTOMER-ID SET CUSTOMER-FOUND TO TRUE END-IF ``` Mark Customer as Found Upon Successful ID Match-L_FIND-CUSTOMER: ```cobol IF CUST-ID = WS-CURRENT-CUSTOMER-ID SET CUSTOMER-FOUND TO TRUE END-IF ``` Return Customer Found Result to Billing Process-L_MAIN-PROCESS: ```cobol PERFORM FIND-CUSTOMER IF CUSTOMER-FOUND IF CUST-STATUS = "ACTIVE" PERFORM CALCULATE-BILL PERFORM GENERATE-INVOICE ``` Return Customer Not Found Result to Billing Process-L_MAIN-PROCESS: ```cobol ELSE DISPLAY "ERROR: CUSTOMER NOT FOUND - " WS-CURRENT-CUSTOMER-ID END-IF ```

3: Validate Customer Status

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Customer Existence Validation Before Billing-L_1: ```cobol IF CUSTOMER-FOUND ``` Customer Existence Validation Before Billing-L_2: ```cobol ELSE DISPLAY "ERROR: CUSTOMER NOT FOUND - " WS-CURRENT-CUSTOMER-ID END-IF ``` Active Customer Status Validation Before Billing-L_1: ```cobol IF CUST-STATUS = "ACTIVE" ``` Active Customer Status Validation Before Billing-L_2: ```cobol ELSE DISPLAY "ERROR: CUSTOMER IS NOT ACTIVE - " WS-CURRENT-CUSTOMER-ID END-IF ``` Proceed to Billing for Active Customers-L_1: ```cobol IF CUSTOMER-FOUND IF CUST-STATUS = "ACTIVE" PERFORM CALCULATE-BILL PERFORM GENERATE-INVOICE ``` Skip Billing and Log Error for Not-Found Customer-L_1: ```cobol ELSE DISPLAY "ERROR: CUSTOMER NOT FOUND - " WS-CURRENT-CUSTOMER-ID END-IF ``` Skip Billing and Log Error for Inactive Customer-L_1: ```cobol ELSE DISPLAY "ERROR: CUSTOMER IS NOT ACTIVE - " WS-CURRENT-CUSTOMER-ID END-IF ```

4: Determine Usage Rate

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Assign Tier 1 Low Usage Rate for Up to 500 Units-L1: ```cobol WHEN WS-USAGE-UNITS <= 500 MOVE 0.50 TO WS-RATE ``` Assign Tier 2 Medium Usage Rate for 501 to 1000 Units-L2: ```cobol WHEN WS-USAGE-UNITS <= 1000 MOVE 0.45 TO WS-RATE ``` Assign Tier 3 High Usage Rate for More Than 1000 Units-L3: ```cobol WHEN OTHER MOVE 0.40 TO WS-RATE ``` Calculate Usage Charge from Units and Assigned Rate-L4: ```cobol COMPUTE WS-USAGE-CHARGE = WS-USAGE-UNITS * WS-RATE ```

5: Calculate Usage Charge

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Compute Gross Usage Charge from Units and Rate-L1: ```cobol COMPUTE WS-USAGE-CHARGE = WS-USAGE-UNITS * WS-RATE ``` Retrieve Total Units Consumed from Usage Record-L2: ```cobol NOT AT END MOVE USAGE-UNITS TO WS-USAGE-UNITS ``` Retrieve Applicable Per-Unit Rate Based on Usage Tier-L3: ```cobol EVALUATE TRUE WHEN WS-USAGE-UNITS <= 500 MOVE 0.50 TO WS-RATE WHEN WS-USAGE-UNITS <= 1000 MOVE 0.45 TO WS-RATE WHEN OTHER MOVE 0.40 TO WS-RATE END-EVALUATE ``` Store Gross Usage Charge for Downstream Discount Processing-L4: ```cobol COMPUTE WS-USAGE-CHARGE = WS-USAGE-UNITS * WS-RATE ```

6: Apply Volume Discount

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Volume Discount Eligibility Check Based on Units Consumed-L_1: ```cobol IF WS-USAGE-UNITS > WS-VOLUME-THRESHOLD END-IF ``` Volume Discount Amount Calculation at 10% of Usage Charge-L_1: ```cobol IF WS-USAGE-UNITS > WS-VOLUME-THRESHOLD COMPUTE WS-DISCOUNT = WS-USAGE-CHARGE * WS-VOLUME-DISCOUNT-RATE END-IF ```

7: Apply Premium Customer Discount

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Rule Premium_Customer_Type_Check-L_1: ```cobol IF CUST-TYPE = "PREMIUM" ``` Rule Premium_Discount_Computation-L_2: ```cobol COMPUTE WS-DISCOUNT = WS-DISCOUNT + (WS-USAGE-CHARGE * WS-PREMIUM-DISCOUNT-RATE) END-IF ```

8: Apply Minimum Charge Rule

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Apply Minimum Charge Floor When Net Charge Falls Below $25.00-L_1: ```cobol IF WS-USAGE-CHARGE - WS-DISCOUNT < WS-MINIMUM-CHARGE MOVE WS-MINIMUM-CHARGE TO WS-TAXABLE-AMOUNT END-IF ``` Use Net Charge as Taxable Amount When At or Above Minimum Charge of $25.00-L_1: ```cobol ELSE COMPUTE WS-TAXABLE-AMOUNT = WS-USAGE-CHARGE - WS-DISCOUNT END-IF ``` Calculate Net Charge as Basis for Minimum Charge Comparison-L_1: ```cobol IF WS-USAGE-CHARGE - WS-DISCOUNT < WS-MINIMUM-CHARGE ```

9: Calculate Tax

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Compute Tax Amount Using Customer-Specific Tax Rate-L1: ```cobol COMPUTE WS-TAX = WS-TAXABLE-AMOUNT * CUST-TAX-RATE ``` Customer Tax Rate is Individually Assigned Per Customer-L2: ```cobol COMPUTE WS-TAX = WS-TAXABLE-AMOUNT * CUST-TAX-RATE ``` Taxable Amount Feeds Into Tax Calculation-L3: ```cobol IF WS-USAGE-CHARGE - WS-DISCOUNT < WS-MINIMUM-CHARGE MOVE WS-MINIMUM-CHARGE TO WS-TAXABLE-AMOUNT ELSE COMPUTE WS-TAXABLE-AMOUNT = WS-USAGE-CHARGE - WS-DISCOUNT END-IF COMPUTE WS-TAX = WS-TAXABLE-AMOUNT * CUST-TAX-RATE ```

10: Calculate Final Invoice Amount

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Retrieve Taxable Amount as Input to Final Invoice Calculation-L1: ```cobol IF WS-USAGE-CHARGE - WS-DISCOUNT < WS-MINIMUM-CHARGE MOVE WS-MINIMUM-CHARGE TO WS-TAXABLE-AMOUNT ELSE COMPUTE WS-TAXABLE-AMOUNT = WS-USAGE-CHARGE - WS-DISCOUNT END-IF ``` Retrieve Calculated Tax Amount as Input to Final Invoice Calculation-L2: ```cobol COMPUTE WS-TAX = WS-TAXABLE-AMOUNT * CUST-TAX-RATE ``` Retrieve Customer Previous Outstanding Balance from Customer Record-L3: ```cobol COMPUTE WS-FINAL-AMOUNT = WS-TAXABLE-AMOUNT + WS-TAX + CUST-PREV-BALANCE ``` Compute Final Invoice Amount by Summing All Billing Components-L4: ```cobol COMPUTE WS-FINAL-AMOUNT = WS-TAXABLE-AMOUNT + WS-TAX + CUST-PREV-BALANCE ```

11: Generate Invoice Number

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Rule: Clear Invoice Number Field-L1: ```cobol MOVE SPACES TO WS-INVOICE-NUMBER WS-OUTPUT-LINE ``` Rule: Invoice Number Source - Billing Month from Usage Record-L2: ```cobol MOVE USAGE-MONTH TO WS-BILLING-MONTH ``` Rule: Invoice Number Source - Customer ID from Customer Record-L3: ```cobol IF CUST-ID = WS-CURRENT-CUSTOMER-ID SET CUSTOMER-FOUND TO TRUE END-IF ``` Rule: Invoice Number Construction by Combining Billing Month and Customer ID-L4: ```cobol STRING WS-BILLING-MONTH DELIMITED BY SIZE "-" CUST-ID DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO WS-INVOICE-NUMBER END-STRING ``` Rule: Invoice Number Uniqueness Per Customer Per Billing Month-L5: ```cobol STRING WS-BILLING-MONTH DELIMITED BY SIZE "-" CUST-ID DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO WS-INVOICE-NUMBER END-STRING WRITE INVOICE-RECORD FROM WS-OUTPUT-LINE ```

12: Format Invoice Output

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Format-Usage-Charge-L1: ```cobol MOVE WS-USAGE-CHARGE TO WS-DISPLAY-CHARGE ``` Format-Discount-Amount-L2: ```cobol MOVE WS-DISCOUNT TO WS-DISPLAY-DISCOUNT ``` Format-Tax-Amount-L3: ```cobol MOVE WS-TAX TO WS-DISPLAY-TAX ``` Format-Previous-Balance-L4: ```cobol MOVE CUST-PREV-BALANCE TO WS-DISPLAY-BALANCE ``` Format-Total-Amount-L5: ```cobol MOVE WS-FINAL-AMOUNT TO WS-DISPLAY-TOTAL ```

13: Write Invoice Record

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Invoice Number Generation from Billing Month and Customer ID-L_GENERATE-INVOICE: ```cobol MOVE SPACES TO WS-INVOICE-NUMBER STRING WS-BILLING-MONTH DELIMITED BY SIZE "-" CUST-ID DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO WS-INVOICE-NUMBER END-STRING ``` Invoice Record Field Assembly with All Billing Components-L_GENERATE-INVOICE: ```cobol MOVE WS-USAGE-CHARGE TO WS-DISPLAY-CHARGE MOVE WS-DISCOUNT TO WS-DISPLAY-DISCOUNT MOVE WS-TAX TO WS-DISPLAY-TAX MOVE CUST-PREV-BALANCE TO WS-DISPLAY-BALANCE MOVE WS-FINAL-AMOUNT TO WS-DISPLAY-TOTAL STRING WS-INVOICE-NUMBER DELIMITED BY SIZE "|" CUST-ID DELIMITED BY SIZE "|" CUST-NAME DELIMITED BY SIZE "|" WS-USAGE-UNITS DELIMITED BY SIZE "|" WS-DISPLAY-CHARGE DELIMITED BY SIZE "|" WS-DISPLAY-DISCOUNT DELIMITED BY SIZE "|" WS-DISPLAY-TAX DELIMITED BY SIZE "|" WS-DISPLAY-BALANCE DELIMITED BY SIZE "|" WS-DISPLAY-TOTAL DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO WS-OUTPUT-LINE END-STRING ``` Write Completed Invoice Record to Invoice Output File-L_GENERATE-INVOICE: ```cobol WRITE INVOICE-RECORD FROM WS-OUTPUT-LINE ``` Invoice Generation Confirmation Display-L_GENERATE-INVOICE: ```cobol DISPLAY "INVOICE GENERATED: " WS-INVOICE-NUMBER ```

14: Billing Process Completion

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Billing-Process-Completion-L1: ```cobol CLOSE CUSTOMER-FILE USAGE-FILE INVOICE-FILE ``` Billing-Process-Completion-L2: ```cobol DISPLAY "----------------------------------------" DISPLAY "BILL01 BILLING PROCESS COMPLETE" DISPLAY "----------------------------------------" STOP RUN. ```
